name: M5.TupleCompletion.divisibility_sum
statement: ∀ (P Z : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (T d k : ℕ) (t : Fin k → Fin (T / d)), (P ∣ Z + M5.ArithmeticTuple.tuplePolynomial T d k t ↔ AdjoinRoot.mk P (M5.ArithmeticTuple.tuplePolynomial T d k t) = AdjoinRoot.mk P Z)
queries: finite set cardinality bijection natural division
guidance: Use AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_zero and map_add. Binary quotient has x+x=0, so x+y=0 iff y=x. No nonzero selected residue or irreducibility premise. Return only tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.
